title: Verify: User data isolation works correctly
description: Verify that two different authenticated users have completely separate data. REQUIRES BROWSER - only Claude can verify.

acceptanceCriteria.text: User A logs in and practices a song - data saved
User B logs in from same browser
User B sees EMPTY dashboard (no User A data)
User B practices - their own data saved
User A logs back in - sees only their data
Leaderboard shows both users with separate stats

notes: This is the critical verification that user data isolation works. Use two different emails to test.
